records.sourceAnchor: DC MSME ZED page sections Key Benefits, Eligibility/Applicability, Implementing Agency and How to apply
observations: The current DC MSME page describes ZED as a three-level certification route: Bronze, Silver and Gold, with displayed fee examples of INR 10,000, INR 40,000 and INR 90,000.

The same page displays a INR 10,000 joining reward, certification-cost subsidy rates of 80%, 60% and 50% for micro, small and medium enterprises, and additional categories subject to the published conditions.
The eligibility statement is for manufacturing MSMEs registered with the Udyam portal; Quality Council of India is identified as the implementing agency.
Testing, quality/product certification, handholding and technology-upgradation support are separate support categories. They are not one direct grant and must remain separate benefit buckets.

The official operational-guideline search result exposes a terminology/version conflict by listing five levels including Diamond and Platinum, while the current DC MSME page states three levels. UdyamVeda must not expose Diamond or Platinum, or merge versions, until the controlling current document is resolved by a reviewer.
Certification requires the official pledge, assessment and applicable evidence; certification or subsidy is not guaranteed by registration, payment or application alone.
UdyamVeda may explain readiness and prepare a checklist, but it must not certify the enterprise, promise a subsidy or submit through the official portal on the applicant's behalf.
